theme.mood: Atmospheric, arcane, worn, candlelight, gritty, mysterious
theme.inspiration: Dark and Darker, Diablo, D&D Grimoires
theme.overall_feel: A weathered medieval tome or dungeon inventory system. Heavy, physical, and historical, avoiding modern flat UI aesthetics.

headings.style: Gothic, classical, textured. Use for Class names, loadout titles, and major sections.

body.style: Arcane text, readable for item descriptions and flavor text.

ui_elements.style: Use only for highly dense numerical stats to guarantee readability on small mobile screens.

spacing_and_layout.mobile_strategy: Split Vertical View. ~35% Left Sidebar for Stats, ~65% Right Area for Equipment Slots.
spacing_and_layout.container_padding: Tight padding (p-2 or p-3) to maximize screen real estate for the game stats.
spacing_and_layout.gap: gap-2 or gap-3 to feel dense, similar to a real complex RPG inventory.
spacing_and_layout.panels: Heavy use of solid borders (tarnished brass) and distinct background textures to separate the stats ledger from the paperdoll (gear slots) area.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Stats should be strictly left-aligned for scannability. Gear slots should be center-aligned in a custom grid.

stats_panel.layout: Fixed on the left side, scrollable vertically, taking up ~35% of the viewport width.
stats_panel.background: Dark parchment or deep stone texture with a 1px tarnished brass right border.
stats_panel.text_style: Dense vertical list. Primary stats highlighted in white or gold. Derived stats in secondary color. Small text sizes (text-xs or text-sm) to fit the data.

equipment_grid.layout: Takes remaining right space. Arranged organically (e.g., Head slot at top center, Chest below it, Weapons on sides, Rings grouped together).
equipment_grid.slot_style: Square or slight portrait boxes. Dark leather/stone backgrounds. 2px tarnished brass borders. Empty state should show a faint grey icon of the slot type.

item_picker_modal.style: Large bottom sheet or full-screen overlay for item selection.
item_picker_modal.background: Deeply dark stone (#151515) with heavy borders.
item_picker_modal.typography: Gold headings, list items color-coded strictly by rarity.
item_picker_modal.list_items: Border-bottom 1px solid #2A2A2A. Show item name and key stat.

rarity_indicators.style: Text color mapping exactly to the rarity. For higher tiers (Epic, Legendary, Unique), include a subtle drop-shadow or text-shadow in the corresponding color to simulate a 'glow'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use React Native primitives (View, Text, ScrollView, Modal, TouchableOpacity) styled with NativeWind/Tailwind classes.

Implement the layout as a 35/65 split: `<View className="flex-row flex-1"> <ScrollView className="w-[35%]">...stats</ScrollView> <ScrollView className="w-[65%]">...gear</ScrollView> </View>` to meet the 'stats on the left' requirement on mobile.
Apply rarity colors rigorously to text and borders when an item is selected. A 'Poor' item must be gray, 'Legendary' orange/gold, etc.
Use standard .js files (not .tsx) as specified in the environment constraints.
All interactive elements MUST include a 'testID' attribute (the React Native equivalent of data-testid) formatted in kebab-case (e.g., testID='gear-slot-head', testID='class-selector-btn').
For backgrounds, use `<ImageBackground>` with the provided media_urls to create the gritty, dark fantasy texture over flat colors.
